title: Binary expansion of a successor
statement: For every natural number $n$, the binary bit list of $n+1$ is obtained by changing each initial $1$ to $0$ until the first $0$, which is changed to $1$; if the list has no such $0$, a $1$ is appended after changing all its bits to $0$.
